source_instruction: i'm looking for 1 resealed bag of puffed snacks
query: Oh man, I just spent ten minutes laughing at the tabby cat curled up on the top of the cereal display earlier? It was kneading a crumpled up granola bar wrapper like it was the coziest blanket in the whole store, and every time a stocker walked by it would freeze and pretend it was just a fancy decorative cat statue someone placed up there. A little kid pointed right at it and yelled that it was stealing snacks, and the cat just blinked slow like it had no idea what the kid was even talking about, like it hadn’t just been caught munching a stray corner of the wrapper two seconds before. I even snapped a blurry photo of it to send to my roommate later, since she’s been begging me to bring home a cat for months and this little troublemaker looked exactly like the kind of chaos she’d adore. I’m in the breakfast foods section right now. I’ve heard the items that come in a self-sealing vacuum canister pack are the ones people tend to look for around here, y’know? I’ve heard the option 1 size is the obvious pick for that, too. I’ve heard folks don’t end up going over that one for the total, yeah?
